# Independent level0 holdout

These three CC0 inputs were fixed after the converter source and six-case
calibration were sealed. Their 7 by 3, 5 by 7 and 9 by 2 images use distinct
edges, odd rows and alpha 0/1/126/129/254/255. Three further authorized complete
native loader calls produced 128 pixels, 512 packed bytes, exactly matching
the unchanged converter. No retry or converter modification followed them.

`native-cpu.json` pins the separate input, converter-freeze and native-result
hashes. Expected RGBA is native BGRA with only red/blue channels exchanged;
it is not generated by the JavaScript converter. The ordinary Node test uses
only these public files and the existing PNG decoder, with no executable,
compiler, private data or local research runner.

The six calibration calls and these three independent calls are native CPU
level0 byte evidence. They establish no GPU, World integration, mip-chain or
CRT sampling result. See `docs/effekseer-texture-level0.md` for the module's
fixed format/capability domain and resource ownership boundary.
